sloka: दिलीपेन महाभाग तव पित्रा अतितेजसा ।पुनर् न शकिता नेतुम् गंगाम् प्रार्थयत अनघ ॥१-४४-११॥
transliteration: dilīpena mahābhāga tava pitrā atitejasā ।punar na śakitā netum gaṁgām prārthayata anagha ॥1-44-11॥

translations.english: O Sinless one (Bhagiratha) O Distinguished one on the part of Dilipa brilliant your father who had the virtuous of a rajarshi, who was equal to a maharshi in splendour, and to me in austerities and abiding to the duties of a kshatriya it was even not possible to bring Ganga through prayer.
translations.hindi: हे रघुनन्दन ! महाराज भगीरथ परमधार्मिक राजपि थे और निस्सन्तान होने से वे सन्तान होने की इच्छा करते थे
